# Codex Rate Monitor v0.3.1

## 中文

### 修复

- 修复右键菜单或弹窗导致悬浮条吸附错位的问题；右下角吸附默认多行，可手动切换单行。（[#8](https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/issues/8)）
- 修复高 DPI 或大缩放下悬浮条宽度截短的问题，保持预览与实际显示一致。

### 改进

- 新增「自动」「全部显示」「仅显示周用量」额度面板，自动适配账号额度。（[#9](https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/issues/9)）
- 重置券数量与到期时间分别跟随对应字号，横排卡片等宽，完整显示到期信息。
- 更新三语 README 和外观截图，修复乱码并增加自动校验。

## English

### Fixes

- Fixed overlay displacement caused by context menus and popups. Bottom-right attachment defaults to multiple rows, with a manual single-row option. ([#8](https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/issues/8))
- Fixed truncated overlay width at high DPI or large scales, keeping the preview and actual display consistent.

### Improvements

- Added Auto, Show all and Weekly usage only panels, with automatic adaptation to available account quotas. ([#9](https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/issues/9))
- Reset-credit counts and expiry text follow their respective font settings. Equal-width horizontal cards show the full expiry text.
- Updated all three READMEs and the appearance screenshot, fixed garbled text and added automated checks.

[Full changelog / 完整变更](https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/compare/v0.3.0...v0.3.1)
